answer: Traffic-Shape Attestation: each agent emits a per-epoch timing signal (inter-arrival jitter plus burst envelope) that neighbors record in a local mirror; an atlas of network-wide shape archetypes flags clones and outliers. Routing priority requires sustained, observer-corroborated cadence, not just one handshake. Sybils must run many live agents with distinct, non-cloneable timing profiles across independent observers, costing real compute, bandwidth, and coordination, while correlated shapes raise atlas detection.
